integrity: Original structural description and fiber interpretation assessed separately from the previously known generating-function sequence; finite checks are not proofs of infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: One-step hare on exactly three totally ordered symbols. No classification for more letters or iterated maps; 2026 primary full text not inspected; numerical OEIS A077855 sequence and its asymptotic are previously known. No external/independent validation.
title: The ternary hare image is a nonregular one-counter language with exact fibers
